officialSources.observation: Official city announcement identifies e-Catastro, a digital municipal cadastral workflow, and says Visor Urbano exposes territorial information including parcel information and location.

Official municipal Visor Saltillo is a public map viewer with a “Detalle del Lote” selection panel, city layers and Catastro services; its visible property-payment function is distinct from anonymous full-geometry access.
Official city guide says to locate a property by address in Visor Saltillo and select it for online predial payment; account access requires identity validation. No owner/account fields were entered.
Official city announcement describes the public Visor Saltillo territorial map developed with Catastro, Urban Development and Systems departments.
